name: @jsw-teams/iask
description: iAsk · 我提问: self-hosted GitHub App comments, isolated widgets and consent-gated website integration.

scripts.build: node --check backend/cloudflare/worker.js && node --check api/service.js && node tools/cli.mjs assets dist
scripts.deploy:vercel: npm run build && npx vercel deploy --prod

COMMENTNEST_SITE_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin of this comment Worker; must match the GitHub App callback host.

COMMENTNEST_WEBSITE_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin of the website embedding this widget. No wildcard.

COMMENTNEST_REPOSITORY.description: GitHub owner/repository with Issues enabled; install your own App here.

COMMENTNEST_GITHUB_APP_ID.description: Numeric App ID shown in your GitHub App settings.

COMMENTNEST_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID.description: Public Client ID shown in your GitHub App settings.

COMMENTNEST_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Complete PEM private key generated in your GitHub App settings.

COMMENTNEST_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret generated in your GitHub App settings.
